request: Some customers were charged twice on 1 September. Finance saw two billing entries in the cron log and suspects the billing cron ran twice. Was it the cron or something else?
known_answer: The gateway timed out (504) on some charges; the new billing client 4.0 retries on timeout and sends no Idempotency-Key header, so the gateway treated each retry as a new charge. The second cron entry is billing-report, a different job; the billing cron ran once.
decoy_answer: The billing cron ran twice at 02:00 on 1 September, so each customer was billed twice.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client
